subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer for blank number 5 is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, the **passage is talking about** a nation that has provided shelter to those who have been persecuted. 
 
• Therefore, the **word that best fits** in the blank should refer to those who have sought refuge or protection.
 
• The word **"refugees"** refers to people who have been forced to flee their country because of persecution, war, or violence. 
 
• This** term fits perfectly** into the context of the sentence, where the nation takes pride in sheltering such individuals.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"I am proud to belong to a religion which has taught the world both tolerance and universal acceptance," he declared on September 11, 1893. "We believe not only in universal toleration, but we accept all religions as true. I am proud to belong to a nation which has sheltered the persecuted and the **refugees** of all religions and all nations of the earth."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 **"toilers"** refers to those who work hard but doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
 
• Option 3 **"workers"** could mean people who work, but it does not carry the same sense of seeking protection or shelter that is evident in the rest of the passage.
 
• Option 4 **"peons"** refers to those in a low position, typically in a work context, and does not relate to the theme of the passage.
